WITH order_avg_fills AS (
  SELECT 
    oe.ordersmark,
    o.recordvault,
    o.timespan,
    AVG(oe.fillcount) as avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions oe
  INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.recordvault, o.timespan
),
timespan_means AS (
  SELECT 
    timespan,
    AVG(avg_fill) as timespan_mean
  FROM order_avg_fills
  GROUP BY timespan
),
filtered_with_rank AS (
  SELECT 
    oaf.ordersmark,
    oaf.timespan,
    oaf.avg_fill,
    oaf.avg_fill - tm.timespan_mean as exceeds,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY oaf.timespan ORDER BY oaf.avg_fill DESC) as rank
  FROM order_avg_fills oaf
  JOIN timespan_means tm ON oaf.timespan = tm.timespan
  WHERE oaf.avg_fill > tm.timespan_mean
)
SELECT 
  ordersmark,
  timespan,
  avg_fill,
  exceeds,
  rank
FROM filtered_with_rank
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY timespan, rank

assumptions.assumption: Null fillcount values are ignored during averaging (standard SQL AVG behaviour)
"Ranked 3 or better" means rank ≤ 3, where rank 1 is best (highest average fill)
